forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 37 of September, teams completed 3 visits, with 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams active. No zone surveys, technical surveys, clearances or zone declarations free were completed this week. So far, 26 zones have been surveyed, 9 declared free, 27 areas released and 12 cleared.

No teams were stood down or had reports missing for more than a week. No reports were held or queried, and no dossiers were held. The access feed shows 8 zones closed. No new plan was approved; the current plan is P09.

The week 36 forecast, for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is done already, gives a P10 to P90 range of 11 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 10 to 10 zones declared free this season.
